items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: There was Harry Shields, Brown Lee, Joe Lloyd Canner, myself, and I can't think of his name

ctx.x: Casual engagements. Harry Shields was on that record. Harry Shields played.

Did he play with you much in those days? Yes. Yes. Mostly. Harry mostly played the clarinet with me all the time. There was Harry Shields, Brown Lee, Joe Lloyd Canner, myself, and I can't think of his name, but it was Brown Lee's brother-in-law that played the banjo.
Oh I have a note on the record, it was French, Barrowman French. That's his name, yeah.

items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: That's Sharky on trumpet, Mike Ryan on drums, myself on bass, Johnny Gregory on sax, and Johnny Miller on piano.

ctx.x: You recognize them? That's Sharky on trumpet, Mike Ryan on drums, myself on bass, Johnny Gregory on sax, and Johnny Miller on piano.
That looks like a baritone, huh?
